placements.title: Brainstorm CLTM / LTM Prep Course
placements.description: Eight week or longer study plan with lectures, printable outlines, flashcards, quizzes and individual tutoring. Listed at $325 for a one time purchase; confirm current terms. Independent of ABRET.

placements.title: Brainstorm R. EEG T. Prep Course
placements.description: Structured EEG review with lesson recordings, outlines, flashcards, quizzes, practice exams and tutoring. Listed at $250 for a one time purchase; confirm current terms. Independent of ABRET.

placements.title: Brainstorm CNIM / IONM Board Prep Course
placements.description: IONM review including anatomy, modalities, instrumentation, anesthesia and troubleshooting workshops. Listed at $375 for a one time purchase; confirm current terms. Independent of ABRET.

placements.title: NTI Neurodiagnostic Technology Program
placements.description: Twelve month EEG training with online instruction and supervised clinical externships. Tuition and admissions requirements apply. A full education program for EEG registry preparation, not a standalone CLTM course.

placements.title: ACNS Long Term and Continuous EEG Guidelines
placements.description: Study reference index for Guideline 12 on epilepsy monitoring, Guideline 14 on critical care terminology, adult and pediatric continuous EEG consensus statements, and neonatal monitoring guidance. Individual publisher access varies.

placements.title: ACNS Critical Care EEG Terminology Reference Chart
placements.description: Public two page reference chart accompanying the 2021 ACNS terminology. Review EEG background, rhythmic and periodic patterns, and seizure terminology alongside the full training materials. No CEU credit established.
placements.badge: Free reference PDF · CLTM study aid

placements.title: ACNS IONM and Evoked Potential Guidelines
placements.description: Study reference index for evoked potentials, intraoperative monitoring standards and spinal monitoring guidance. Select the relevant documents for CNIM preparation; individual publisher access varies.

credit_note: No CEU credit verified for these board preparation or reference resources.
